rationale: B wins because it goes straight at the unresolved money tension in the update instead of treating it as a nuisance. The headline "Does Whatnot's math hold up: $3B in sales, a near-$5B price tag, and a take rate nobody's seen" is the kind of uncomfortable, editor-legible story A literally throws away as "Valuation/funding-mechanics angle ... `no_journalist_shape`." A has cleaner proof checklists, but it spends too much confidence on "Squeezing Resale's Incumbents" and competitor claims the update did not earn.
gaps_in_A: "since TikTok Shop's US launch" imports an outside peg not supplied in the update. It may be true, but this exercise asked for grounded angles, not vibes with a news app logo taped on.

"Poshmark, Depop, and eBay — platforms that don't have a live-auction format to counter with" invents the competitor set and overclaims their product posture. The update only says Whatnot is entering fashion and electronics.
"Asia Has Been Running Live Commerce for a Decade" adds a timeline the update never gave. The supplied fact is only that live commerce is far larger in Asia.

"Valuation/funding-mechanics angle ... `no_journalist_shape`" is the wrong refusal. The update hands you $3B in sales, a nearly $5B valuation, commission economics, and undisclosed take-rate; that is a real finance angle if handled carefully.
gaps_in_B: "Whatnot bets its trading-card crowd will also buy sneakers and laptops" assumes the same buyer cohort migrates into the new categories. The update says categories are expanding, not that trading-card buyers become laptop buyers.
"the first time this scale of number has been put on record" is not supplied. Do not invent disclosure history to make the peg sound fresher.
"Decay: month" is too generous for the Asia trend. With no outside event beyond Whatnot's own announcement, urgency fades faster than that.

"five distinct shapes exist" overstates the set a little. The category-transfer angle and original-seller angle share the same expansion spine, and the valuation and seller-transparency angles both hinge on the undisclosed take-rate.
